units.Si aceptas las cookies de analítica, Goo: If you accept analytics cookies, Google Analytics 4 records browsing data: pages viewed, clicks on links and buttons, time on page, device and browser type, and an approximate location (country or city). Google Analytics 4 does not store full IP addresses.
units.Lo uso solo para una cosa: saber qué con: I use it for one thing only: to learn which content is interesting and improve the portfolio. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and Art. 22.2 of the Spanish LSSI), which you can withdraw whenever you like.
units.Si no aceptas, Google Analytics funciona: If you don’t accept, Google Analytics runs in cookieless mode (Consent Mode): it neither stores nor reads cookies in your browser and only receives anonymous signals that a visit took place, with no identifiers.
units.Si me escribes por correo electrónico, t: If you email me, I’ll use your address and message only to reply to you. The legal basis is your own request and the legitimate interest in answering it.
